messages:
nina: deploy-bot scheduled UNPIN runtime v3.0 -> v3.1 (canary) for 04:00 UTC. tagging runtime, QA, SRE.
deploy-bot: Scheduled action: UNPIN runtime v3.0 -> v3.1 (canary). Trigger: nightly-runtime-window. ETA: 04:00 UTC.
owen: Heads-up: runtime v3.1 changes session token rotation semantics. Could affect long-lived convo sessions persisted by Dedicated SDK.
qa-max: Repro in staging: open convo, continue after token refresh, client sees empty reply. Minimal repro: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer X' /v1/chat/stream` then after 30s token refresh, next reply is 204.
qa-max: Log snippet:
```
WARN session: token_refreshed but session_ctx not linked; returning 204
stack: session_manager.go:142
```
runtime-alex: That's new guard we added to avoid token reuse across tenants. It should have a fallback to re-associate ctx. Looks like fallback didn't run for cached sessions.
sre-zoe: Impact estimate: ~0.2% of requests hit this path in prod, concentrated on large enterprise customers using session-restoration. Recommend pause unpin until we confirm fallback.
pm-rene: If customers hit 204 mid-conversation it's high severity for product demos tomorrow. Suggest notify account owners if we hold >20m.
deploy-bot: PAUSE unpin action for thread 2512345678. Reason: session token fallback regression investigation. (requested by nina)
runtime-alex: Quick triage: found missing addendum in session_cache.go where refreshed tokens set `session.linked=true` only on full handshake. I can push a one-line fix that sets linked on refresh.
own: Please open PR and mark it hotfix. Also add an automated smoke that simulates token refresh in canary harness.
runtime-alex: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/1901 "fix: re-associate session ctx on token refresh"
qa-max: CI for PR queued. ETA ~25m. I'll prepare a 2% canary that targets dedicated tier sessions only.
sre-zoe: I'll add metric alert: session_204_rate > 0.05% => paged.
qa-max: CI green (2512347600). Built canary artifact runtime:v3.1-hotfix-1901.
own: Kicking off scoped canary at 04:40 UTC to 2% of dedicated fleet (session-restoration clients).
qa-max: Observing canary: no session 204s in cohort after 15m; latency stable.
pm-rene: Holding customer comms; will notify only if extended.
own: If clean for 30m, resume unpin. If not, roll back v3.1 and schedule patch release.
deploy-bot: Resuming UNPIN runtime v3.0 -> v3.1: staged canary -> remaining canary -> full roll per policy.
sre-zoe: Monitoring live; alert thresholds in place.
nina: Thanks all, closing thread once rollout finishes. :white_check_mark:
